_how: Add a sponsor to 'sponsors' once a deal is agreed. families = family slugs it covers (whole family); gens = optional list of 'family/gen' for generation-only deals. start/end are YYYY-MM-DD; the card shows only between them. Nothing renders while the list is empty. Packages feed the /partner/ page.
founding: Founding partners: the first three sponsors get 25% off for the first 12 months.

packages.name: Family specialist
what: Your “Recommended specialist” card on the family page, every generation guide in that family, and every repair guide for those trucks
One specialist per family: no competing shop gets that spot while you hold it
A feature in The Boxy Dispatch newsletter each month
A monthly report of clicks from BoxyTrucks to your site

packages.name: Generation specialist

packages.name: Install guide
